Muscat: Otech, the technology arm of Omantel, has announced a new collaboration with Kaspersky, a global cybersecurity and digital privacy company, reinforcing Otech’s role in advancing digital sovereignty in the Sultanate of Oman. The collaboration was announced on the sidelines of GISEC Global 2026 at Dubai Exhibition Centre, Expo City Dubai. Under the collaboration, Otech becomes an authorised Kaspersky Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) partner in Oman. It brings together Kaspersky’s advanced cybersecurity technologies, Otech’s local data centre infrastructure, its cybersecurity operations expertise and its nationwide support network. The collaboration focuses on delivering locally hosted and managed cybersecurity solutions. The Kaspersky solutions covered by the collaboration will operate from Otech’s data centre in Oman, with support and management services delivered locally. This model gives organisations in the Sultanate greater control over their sensitive security data, supports data sovereignty requirements and strengthens their readiness to address evolving cyberthreats. Through the collaboration, Otech will offer Kaspersky Next XDR Optimum and Kaspersky Next XDR Expert in the Omani market. Both solutions will be hosted and fully supported locally. Customers will gain access to enterprise-grade extended detection and response capabilities backed by locally based experts, local data centre infrastructure and round-the-clock support from within the Sultanate, rather than relying on technical support from outside Oman. Commenting on the collaboration, Abdullah Al Ghassani, Team Lead Service Operation at Otech, said: “As digital transformation accelerates across organisations in Oman, the need for cybersecurity that keeps pace with this transformation has never been greater. Organisations need advanced technologies that are hosted locally, supported locally and delivered with local accountability. “This partnership allows us to combine Kaspersky’s proven technologies with the infrastructure, expertise and round-the-clock cybersecurity operations capabilities that we have built here in Oman. It gives our customers a level of control over their security data that a provider operating from outside the Sultanate cannot offer and brings us another step closer to achieving the objectives of Oman Vision 2040.” Rashed Al Momani, General Manager for the Middle East at Kaspersky, said: “Organisations today need cybersecurity solutions that combine advanced technologies, local infrastructure and the expertise required to support their specific operational needs, while also meeting growing data sovereignty requirements. “Through Kaspersky’s partnership with Otech, our customers in Oman will gain access to Kaspersky’s advanced cybersecurity solutions, hosted within a local data environment and supported by Otech’s expertise and round-the-clock security operations capabilities. “This approach gives organisations greater control over where their security data is hosted and managed, helps them strengthen their security posture and enables them to address an increasingly complex cyberthreat landscape. It also marks an important step in expanding our presence in Oman and contributing to the development of a stronger local cybersecurity ecosystem.” About Kaspersky Kaspersky is a global cybersecurity and digital privacy company founded in 1997. With over a billion devices protected to date from emerging cyberthreats and targeted attacks, Kaspersky’s deep threat intelligence and security expertise is constantly transforming into innovative solutions and services to protect individuals, businesses, critical infrastructure, and governments around the globe. The company’s comprehensive security portfolio includes leading digital life protection for personal devices, specialized security products and services for companies, as well as Cyber Immune solutions to fight sophisticated and evolving digital threats. We help millions of individuals and nearly 200,000 corporate clients protect what matters most to them. Learn more at www.kaspersky.com. About Otech As the technology arm of Omantel Group, Otech is strategically positioned to serve as Oman’s national digital champion and a key enabler of the Sultanate’s digital economy, in line with the goals and objectives of Oman Vision 2040. Otech was established by bringing together Omantel Group’s ICT subsidiaries, capabilities and technology partner ecosystem under a unified go-to-market brand. Its formation builds on the transformation of Oman Data Park (ODP), a wholly owned subsidiary of Omantel, positioning Otech as a strategic leader in the Omani technology market with the potential to expand into selected markets beyond the Sultanate. Otech provides a comprehensive and integrated portfolio of ICT services and industry solutions. Its offering includes professional and managed services across data centres, hyperscaler cloud environments, cybersecurity, Internet of Things and smart city solutions, enterprise applications and systems integration. It also encompasses emerging technologies including artificial intelligence, generative AI and machine learning. As a leading ICT solutions provider in Oman, Otech serves major organisations and brands across a wide range of sectors, including government, energy, oil and gas, banking and financial services, logistics, education and healthcare. Otech’s differentiated value proposition is underpinned by the scale and reach of Omantel Group’s nationwide mobile and fixed telecommunications networks, international submarine cable infrastructure, AI-enabled data centres and global multi-cloud ecosystem. These assets are complemented by advanced technologies, deep industry expertise and excellence in service delivery, operations and customer experience. For more information, visit www.otech.om.
